name: The Great Hall
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Dance Manhattan - Long Island swing dances list. Check the name and address; research the dance floor.

Directory research 2026-10-04: 'The Great Hall' is the parish hall of St. John's Episcopal Church (SJH), 12 Prospect St, Huntington. Suggest renaming to 'The Great Hall at St. John's Episcopal Church' so people can find it. Website, logo, socials and contact are the church's. No published hours for the hall. The only photo is the church exterior (no photo of the hall itself on the site); it is a wide banner (1000x369). Concert/dance contact on the arts listing is the music director's line, not recorded.
description: The parish hall of St. John's Episcopal Church, at the corner of Main Street and Prospect Street in Huntington village. Besides church events, it hosts some community concerts and swing dance nights with live bands and a beginner lesson.

Huntington Arts Council listing: St. John's Jazz Connections 'Swing into Spring' with live swing by The Revisionists and dancing in The Great Hall, St. John's Church, with an optional lesson by Courtney and Chris Thaler.
Church events page mentions concerts at SJH and the Harvest Fair bake sale in the Great Hall, at the corner of Main and Prospect.
